declarations.name: retains only explicitly selected checks for exactly covered raw input changes
supersedes only stale applied judgments and rejects a result for reverted content
retains exact approved originals without language normalization or compiler support
uses the current Agent claim without creating another review session
records raw edits for current Agent judgment in %s
recovers a bound independent review without claiming the formal Verifier Action
keeps original input outside Runtime and refuses to reuse a changed input reference
requires the current independent claimed Verifier session
holds the current candidate until its exact reviewed edit is applied
keeps unrelated candidates isolated and refuses conflicting decisions
lets the %s Verifier assess a changed configuration value and require revision
cannot review away execution instructions or formal approvals
discards an unapplied proposal without accepting a changed file
can discard a rejected proposal while retaining its original receipt
recognizes non-behavioral %s edits
requires context review instead of inferring behavior from syntax in %s
declarations.body:
it.each([
    ['main.ts', 'const a: number = 1;', 'const a: any = 1;'],
    ['main.ts', 'const a = f();', 'const a = /* @__PURE__ */ f();'],
    ['main.ts', 'const a = 1;', '// eslint-disable-next-line\nconst a = 1;'],
    [
      'main.ts',
      '// eslint-disable-next-line\nconst a = 1;',
      '// eslint-disable-next-line\n\nconst a = 1;',
    ],
    [
      'main.ts',
      '/// <reference path="types.d.ts" />\nconst a = 1;',
      'const a = 1;\n/// <reference path="types.d.ts" />',
    ],
    ['main.ts', 'function f(){ return 1; }', 'function f(){ return\n1; }'],
    ['main.ts', 'const a = tag`\\n`;', 'const a = tag`\n`;'],
    ['settings.json', '{"enabled":true}', '{"enabled":false}'],
    ['settings.json', '{"value":0}', '{"value":-0}'],
    ['settings.yaml', 'x: .nan\n', 'x: null\n'],
    ['settings.yaml', 'x: .inf\n', 'x: -.inf\n'],
    ['settings.yaml', 'x: yes\n', 'x: true\n'],
    ['settings.yaml', 'x: 1\n', 'x: 1 # yamllint disable-line\n'],
    ['settings.toml', 'x = 2026-10-15T00:00:00Z\n', 'x = "2026-10-15T00:00:00.000Z"\n'],
    ['settings.toml', 'x = 2026-10-15\n', 'x = 2026-10-15T00:00:00Z\n'],
    ['settings.toml', 'x = 2026-10-15T00:00:00Z\n', 'x = 2026-10-15T08:00:00+08:00\n'],
    [
      'main.ts',
      'export function value() { return 1; }',
      'export function value() { const result = 1; return result; }',
    ],
  ])(
    'requires context review instead of inferring behavior from syntax in %s',
    (file, before, after) => {
      expect(classifyEditImpact(file, before, after).kind).toBe('review-required');
    },
  )
